 The No. 21 LSU Tigers have a massive home game in Week 11 against the No. 6 Texas Longhorns. While the program has an opportunity to keep its playoff hopes alive, it's also another opportunity for Lane Kiffin to have another celebrity-packed pregame walkout.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Hours before the scheduled 7:30 p.m. EST kickoff, Sports Illustrated spoke with Kiffin's daughter, Landry, about his extravagant entrances to home games in his first year as LSU's head coach. She revealed how impressed she is with how many fans show up just for the pregame walk down Victory Hill, and how the celebrities add even more excitement to the experience.
 "The Tiger Walk, I've just never seen so many people so excited for one thing," Landry Kiffin said. "Like there's this picture, and you can't even see the ground at all. People are just lined up, trying to touch the players, get a signature, or just yelling their names. There's some dedicated fans for sure."

 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Lane Kiffin walked out with several LSU legends in the Tigers' last home game (31-13 Week 10 loss to the Alabama Crimson Tide). Shaquille O'Neal, Paul Skenes, and Angel Reese were all spotted walking down Victory Hill with the 51-year-old head coach. Even famous actor Kevin Costner was present, despite not being an LSU alumnus.
 Click Above to Subscribe We'll see who joins Kiffin on Saturday. This will be the final pregame walk of the campaign, as LSU's final two games after Week 11 are on the road. With it being the final home game of the season, perhaps this could be a grand finale group of celebrities to walk with Kiffin before taking on Texas.
